excerpt: Assess Dubai's 2027 property outlook through the latest available supply, demand and transaction evidence, with scenarios and property-level checks.
introduction:
Dubai's 2027 residential outlook depends on how many homes are completed, where they are delivered and how demand responds. The latest evidence available for this article is from the third quarter of 2026; it describes a market with moderating activity and a substantial scheduled pipeline. Use the outlook alongside local transaction evidence and the details of each property.

Use the figures as dated context, then examine the specific building, competing supply, affordability and your holding period. Forecast deliveries can change or be delayed. This outlook should be refreshed as new evidence becomes available.
takeaways: Q3 2026 reports describe moderation, but their measures and coverage differ and should not be combined as one series.
Scheduled supply is not completed supply; location and timing matter to an individual home.
Stress-test rent, vacancy, borrowing and resale rather than relying on a single 2027 prediction.

sections.heading: What did the latest reports show?
sections.body:
[Savills' Q3 2026 residential report](https://dubai.savills.ae/research_articles/379881/395342-0/dubai-residential-market-report-q3-2026) recorded approximately 34,500 residential transactions in the quarter, down 4% from Q2, with AED 70.8 billion of transacted value. It described moderating activity and noted that changes in the mix of properties affected headline figures. These are its reported definitions, not all Dubai real estate transactions.

[Cushman & Wakefield Core's Q3 report](https://www.cushwake.ae/en/marketbeats/marketbeat-residential-q3-2026-dubai-uae) reported nearly 12,900 residential units delivered in Q3 and about 40,400 in the first nine months. It expected a further 10,500 in Q4, taking its forecast for 2026 to approximately 50,900. The Q4 figure was a projection at the report date, not a completed count.

Different reports can use different coverage and methods. Compare like with like and look beyond a city-wide average when assessing a home.

sections.heading: How should buyers interpret scheduled supply?
sections.body:
Savills reported more than 525,000 residential units scheduled for delivery across 2027–2030. That is a multi-year pipeline, not a count for 2027 alone and not evidence that every scheduled unit will be completed on time. Some projects may change scope or handover date.

Cushman & Wakefield Core's 2026 estimates illustrate the distinction between completed and expected supply. Its first-nine-month count and Q4 forecast are shown separately in the chart; only the former was reported as delivered when the report was published. Their sum is the firm's full-year forecast, not a guarantee.

For an apartment purchase, identify competing projects within the relevant catchment, their likely handover dates and the type of units offered. A city-wide pipeline cannot establish vacancy in one tower.

sections.heading: What could support or weaken demand?
sections.body:
Household formation, employment, population movement, borrowing costs and the relative cost of renting or buying all affect demand. Their influence differs by location and property type. An apartment close to a tenant's daily needs may compete differently from a home with a distant handover or a less usable layout.

[JLL's Q3 2026 UAE living update](https://www.jll.com/en-ae/insights/market-dynamics/uae-living) reported a 19.8% quarterly increase in Dubai secondary-market transactions while noting that annual transactions remained below the previous year's exceptional highs. A quarterly change and an annual comparison measure different things; neither guarantees a trend in 2027.

For rental demand, compare recent signed leases in similar buildings and check the time needed to let. Listings and asking rents are useful context, but they are not the same as signed leases or collected income.

sections.heading: Build scenarios instead of a single forecast
sections.body:
In a stronger-demand scenario, a home may let promptly even as new units arrive. In a weaker scenario, the owner may face a lower rent, longer vacancy or more competition at resale. In either case, actual outcomes depend on the property and timing. These are planning scenarios, not forecasts or probabilities.

Calculate annual rent after a vacancy allowance, then deduct the owner's service charges, repairs, management and insurance. Test the result with a lower rent and an unexpected repair. For a mortgage, add the repayment schedule separately and maintain cash for periods without a tenant.

If buying off-plan, compare the payment calendar with available funds and ask what happens if handover is delayed. Do not assume a future sale or rental income will arrive in time to fund a contractual instalment.

sections.heading: Check the area and the building
sections.body:
The [JVC and Arjan comparison](/journal/jvc-vs-arjan-apartment-investment-comparison) shows how two Dubai apartment areas can be compared using the specific building, service charges and likely tenant needs. Check actual access, parking, facilities, condition and the competing units near your shortlist.

Verify the right to buy, the registered project, title or initial registration and the developer's documentation. Ask for an itemised current fee quote and a written statement of building charges. For a ready home, inspect the apartment and review any existing lease or mortgage.

Use the [Dubai market guide](/journal/dubai-property-market-2026) as additional context, but refresh its older evidence before relying on it for a new decision.

sections.heading: Watch the evidence through 2027
sections.body:
Track completed handovers alongside revised schedules, signed rents for comparable units and transaction evidence in the chosen community. Watch how long comparable homes remain available and whether their terms change. None of these measures should be interpreted alone: a lower asking rent may reflect a different mix of homes, and a delayed handover may shift competition into a later period.

Record the date and source of each update so that a forecast can be distinguished from an observed result. Revisit the investment assumptions when a new project or financing offer materially changes the comparison.

sections.heading: Review current options and update the evidence
sections.body:
Browse the [Aliyas Dubai project collection](/projects?emirate=Dubai) and ask for current availability and terms for specific units. [Contact Aliyas](/contact) with your intended use, budget and timing to discuss a shortlist.

Before a purchase or publication decision, update this outlook with the latest official and independent figures, including their periods and definitions. A 2027 title does not make a 2026 forecast a completed result.
